name: Medallion  Vehicles - Authorized
description:
This dataset contains records of authorized medallion vehicles, most likely New York City taxis, with one row per licensed vehicle. Each record includes the medallion license number, the name of the owner or driver, the medallion type (named driver or owner must drive), current status, DMV license plate number, vehicle identification number (VIN), model year, and vehicle type. It also lists the licensing agent's number and name where available, along with the date and time the record was last updated. Several agent contact fields (telephone, website, address) are present as columns but are empty throughout.

The data supports looking up and verifying individual vehicle licenses, analyzing the fleet by model year, medallion type, or vehicle type, and monitoring license status. It can also help identify which agents handle which licenses and support regulatory oversight or research into taxi fleet composition and licensing patterns.
